model: BREITLING Chronomat B01 42 AB0134101B1A1 (42 mm steel, black dial, steel rouleaux bracelet, chronograph)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). Breitling approach (Superocean 42 / Heritage 42) with the chronograph parts of the Tudor Black Bay Chrono step: rider-tab tachymeter bezel (one steel flange, tabs and ticks in the projected photo), hour / minute bar hands, red chronograph seconds hand with a kite lume window, three sub-dials with white hands and hubs, crown with guards carried by the silhouette, two rectangular pushers radial at +-30 deg, 42 mm steel rouleaux bracelet (five-segment rows alternating with full-width tubes) built by pipeline/steps/watch_breitling_chronomat42.py.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug tops y 219, bottoms y 749.5 px); the crown / pusher rows take the straight shoulder line (right_override_px), guards stay in the silhouette; top and bottom slope toward the bracelet

bezel.note: one steel lathe: flange bezel_in..insert_out (z_insert, rider tabs / ticks / numerals come from the projected photo) and the darker lower outer chamfer ring insert_out..bezel_out (z_coin below z_insert gives the step)

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, measured as the thr-120 silhouette in rotated strips (hour / minute are bare polished bars, 0.04..0.1 mm wider than the bright part so the 3D hands hide the photographed ones; the dark facet beside them stays in the map); the last point sits at the traced length. Seconds = red needle with the kite (lume = white window inside). Sub-dial hands are polygons (hands.polygons, mm about the pivot) over the sub-dial hubs (hands.discs). Hands / hubs use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: fluted barrel crown x 740..797 px, y 448..518 (silhouette half width 36 px at x 768 tapering to 27.5 at 788, 19 at 794), centre y 483 (the guards stay in the silhouette: right_override_px rows 438..526 end at x 766.5)

bracelet.note: Rouleaux bracelet (10.8429 px/mm, pivot (512.2, 477.5)): rows alternate between full-width tubes (kind tube) and five-segment rows (outer, pol, centre, pol, outer). Top rows from the pivot outwards (photo y): E 213.5..246.8 (between the lugs, outer columns end at x 395 / 628.3 px), tube D 186.5..213.5, C 149.5..186.5, tube B 123..149.5, A 107..123, cap strip 101.5..107; bottom: E' 717.5..752.5 (between the lugs), tube 752.5..793.5, C' 793.5..827.5, tube 827.5..861.5, A' 861.5..892, tube 892..913.5, end strip 913.5..919.5; boundaries at the dark joint lines. Joint columns (polished segments) from horizontal gradient scans on the 5-segment rows (top x 442..445 / 474.5..475.5 / 548..549 / 579..580.5, bottom 443..447 / 475..478 / 550..551 / 582).

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

pushers.note: two chronograph pushers: rectangular blocks, axis radial from the crown-axis point (512.2, 483) px at +-30 deg, end face 272.3 px (25.1 mm) from it (silhouette scan along the axis), 54 px wide (rounded corners), modelled as plain cylinders (r 2.45 mm)
